bridge_assumptions: Selection eligibility/evaluation includes all relevant state, rollback and reads; reached agreement is a premise.
Initial models the non-inherited Initial skip; literal models a resolved target value. No CSS finish decoder is derived.
An unrelated action must preserve all relevant target/effect state and cannot consume a not-final target; actual generated dependencies are not proved unrelated.
Publication and observation lists are abstract semantic effects, not an instrumented Rust trace.
The target field omits seen, eligibility flags, font/scheme caches and SCC state; the native implementation must additionally protect these effects.
